decisions_this_run: The demo identity provider must obey the tenant-access seam. It is a live authentication path in dev and test, and tests/conftest.py's client runs against it; skipping the rule there teaches the suite a model production rejects.
Reuse ensure_tenant_access rather than reading memberships in the provider. A second copy of the rule is how the five paths drifted apart.

Reconcile the two org tests by giving Bob a second active membership; do not change their expected 404/422 to 401. The originals asserted org visibility and terminal offboarding, and a status change would have redefined them to 'the caller is signed out' -- weaker, and it would have hidden that they had been measuring authentication.
Keep the docstring enumeration honest: it now names the demo provider as the fifth path, because it twice under-counted (three, then four).
